notes.title: Idle Cave Miner 2 - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43688931/db5c735f7fa2813dc18dc5ae2e25e20f29b431f0.png
Are you ready for this new chapter?

I've been working on Idle Cave Miner for over 4 years now, it started as a hobby project that I worked on when I had some free time. I never expected much of it, but 4 years and 1.5 Million downloads later, it has become my full-time job, which still doesn't feel real to me.

When I first made ICM, I had no idea how a game should flow, what made a good idle game, what elements players like, how to design progression, and many other things. These past years have been a big learning experience, and I now have the opportunity to put everything I learned into something new.

Thank you for being with me on this journey, I couldn't ask for a better community!

With that said, it's with great pleasure that I announce Idle Cave Miner 2, coming soon to Steam!

Wishlist now to be notified when it releases:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3340830/Idle_Cave_Miner_2/

What's new on Idle Cave Miner 2:

Idle Cave Miner 2 takes everything you loved about the first game and makes it better than ever with a fresh new look, completely reworked progression, an updated roster of miners, pets, a market, global leaderboards and so much more! New worlds have been added, including a Combat World, where you'll be able to fight monsters and defeat bosses to acquire unique items.

How much will it cost?

Idle Cave Miner 2 will be Free to Play.

When does it release?

The is no estimate yet, when I have one, I will make an announcement.

Follow my socials to be up-to-date in any news:

 X (former Twitter): https://x.com/coldhoursdev
 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@coldhoursdev
 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/IdleCaveMiner/ 
 Discord: https://discord.gg/idle-cave-miner-1012009692370829482

What's next?

The game will soon enter alpha testing phase with a very small amount of players to test all the new features, and get some early feedback on all the new changes.


Thank you for making all of this possible.
~Pedro

notes.title: Idle Cave Miner is going Free to Play
notes.content:
Hello fellow miners,

I would like to start by thanking each and every one of you for playing Idle Cave Miner, and for leaving both positive and negative feedback, this process is essential for me to keep improving the game.

As you're probably aware, the game didn't have the best launch, not because of bugs, but because of a series of bad decisions from my part, and for that, I would like to profoundly apologize.

The main critique was the fact that the game was paid, and still had MTX, which is a very fair argument. In hindsight, I should've released the game as Free to Play, and modify the shop to fit the ad restriction from Steam. At the time, I went for the easiest solution, which was to auto purchase the 'Skip Ads' purchase, and keep the game the same as the mobile version.

In order to rectify my mistakes, Idle Cave Miner is becoming Free to Play on Steam. To the players who have already purchased the game on Steam, they will keep the skip ads purchase they received when buying the Steam version, but they will also receive the following:

 5600 Premium Gems
 50 Singularities of Time

The Skip Ads purchase is going to be modified on Steam, it will now double the amount of premium birds available, the default is now 5, and this purchase increases it to 10, as well as doubling offline rewards, and all the other boosts ads give on the mobile version. If you already own it, nothing changes, you still have 10 daily premium birds.
The game will become F2P on Steam with version 1.10, which also brings new content and quality of life changes.

It wasn't easy to read the negative comments made about the game, but they were necessary for me to understand what my mistakes were, and how to fix them. I can't say I won't do any more mistakes, but I care, and I'll try my best to keep learning, and to keep improving Idle Cave Miner, I'm blessed to be able to do what I love for a job, and I want to continue doing it, alongside the community that rose around the game.

Thank you so much for playing, and see you on the mines...
~Pedro
